summary.title: INGMA INVEST AS

narrative.text: INGMA INVEST AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Andre egeninvesteringsselskaper", registered 2006-01-11.
Registered activity: Eie og investere i aksjer samt deltakelse i andre virksomheter.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2023 show revenue of NOK 2.2 million and an annual result of NOK 2.0 million.
Registered leadership: Einar Jørgensen (Daglig leder); Einar Jørgensen (Styrets leder).
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
